about_the_game:
Once, all living beings, animals and plants, were connected to the magic that permeated the world. But the fragile balance between order and chaos shattered corrupting minds and tainting magic with madness.

In this devastated world, a few individuals still resist madness and fight against chaos. Using ancient knowledge, construct your deck of magic cards to survive hordes of enemies and try to defeat bringers of chaos.

Build your deck : 

While surviving assaults from strange creatures you will collect gems and cards filled with magic!

Use theses cards wisely to upgrade your character’s skills and gain more power. 

Be aware : the magic trapped within the cards has a cost, you’ll learn it the hard way!

What you’ll find in Amentia :

  • 3 maps with 3 levels of difficulty.

  • 3 characters, each with unique cards and playstyle.

  • Challenging boss fights.

  • A real deckbuilding experience where cards matter.

  • Actives and passives cards.

  • RNG : your cards are shuffled and drawn in different order.

  • All hand-drawn visuals and animations.

Choose your gameplay :

You have the possibility to choose when you play your cards in order to unleash powerful combos or to have a more casual experience by using the « automatic mode ».
